title: Weight-spectrum outliers as a data-free backdoor signal
description: Heavy-tailed self-regularization theory reads training history from the singular value spectra of weight matrices. Poisoning teaches a model one extra, very strong input-output rule, which should show up as an outlying top singular value relative to the bulk. Score each model by the ratio of the largest to the second-largest singular value across its layers. Needs no data at all.

source.title: Implicit self-regularization in deep neural networks: evidence from random matrix theory and implications for learning
